lines.en: I walk over to the soccer field to see how Miku and the rest of the team are doing.
lines.zh: 我走到足球场，看看 Miku 和队里其他人怎么样。

lines.en: She notices me right away and runs up to me with the same level of excitement as always.
lines.zh: 她立刻注意到我，像往常一样兴奋地朝我跑过来。

lines.en: I thought her enthusiasm might have died down a bit after I became the coach, but it's become easily apparent that this is not the case.
lines.zh: 我本以为我当上教练之后，她那股热情会消退一点，不过现在显而易见并非如此。

lines.en: Regardless, I take a seat on the sidelines and watch as a group of attractive and fit [teenage]girls kick a ball around.
lines.zh: 不管怎样，我在场边坐下，看着一群又好看又结实的少女踢球。

lines.en: It's something I wouldn't mind watching all day, but eventually practice comes to an end and I need to find something else to do...
lines.zh: 那是我看一整天都不介意的东西，不过训练最终还是会结束，我得找点别的事做……

lines.en: Just like she does every time I'm here, Miku tries coaxing me into being the new coach.
lines.zh: 就像我每次来这儿一样，Miku 试着哄我当新教练。

lines.en: Knowing absolutely nothing about soccer, I decline and Miku goes back to yelling at the rest of the girls to speed up."
lines.zh: 我对足球一无所知，只好拒绝，Miku 便回头继续冲其他女孩喊，叫她们快点。"

lines.en: I stay and watch for a little while before realizing that I probably look like a creep and decide to get on with the rest of my day..."
lines.zh: 我留在那儿看了一会儿，然后意识到自己大概看起来像个变态，决定继续过我这一天……"
